name: ChuuChuumon
main_effect:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Bagra Army] in any of its traits and 1 [Yuu Amano] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] When this card is trashed from digivolution cards by an effect, gain 1 memory.
